pass_a_gloss: And he-bent heaven, and he-came-down, and gloom under the feet of-him, and he-mounted upon Cherubim. Cherubim is-interpreted knowledge and understanding; into the righteous then he-speaks.
pass_b_english: “And he bent heaven, and came down, and gloom under his feet, and he mounted upon cherubim” (Psalm 17:10-11).
Cherubim is interpreted knowledge and understanding; therefore he speaks unto the righteous.

choices.english: cherubim is interpreted knowledge and understanding
choices.why: Etymology/gloss, spoken unto the righteous. Not ‘cherubim are clouds’.

anf_compare.notes: ANF lacks this Greek catena as reading English.
